pages.quiz:
ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the Library
   D. Where is the library?

2. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goes
   B. went
   C. going
   D. goed

3. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Only one word repeated
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. One main idea with supporting sentences
   D. No full stops

4. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. run
   B. blue
   C. happiness
   D. quickly

5. When practising Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Punctuation.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Punctuation.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Punctuation.

6. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.

7. When practising Language Activities at home, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Language Activities at home.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Language Activities at home.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language Activities at home.

8. When practising Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Spelling.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Spelling.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Spelling.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.

9. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.

10. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. Only an action
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only a joining word

11. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.

12. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening.

13. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.

14. When practising Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Guided Writing.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Writing.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Guided Writing.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Writing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Word Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Language Activities at home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Spelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
